mporaryDirectory(prefix=\"chupa-serve-premise-\") as temporary:
        rig = CoreRig(Path(temporary))
        assert_core_wiring(rig)
        llm = FakeLLM([])
        captured = []
        factory_code = Driver.from_config.__func__.__code__
        def profile(frame, event, result):
            if event == \"return\" and frame.f_code is factory_code:
                captured.append(result)
        previous = sys.getprofile()
        sys.setprofile(profile)
        try:
            assert await triage.triage_pass(rig.checkout, llm) == []
        finally:
            sys.setprofile(previous)
        assert len(captured) == 1
        driver = captured[0]
        assert driver.journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is driver.journal
        assert driver.effects._journal is not rig.checkout.journal
        assert driver.journal.dir == rig.checkout.journal.dir
